content.value: A four-port multimode fiber FBT coupler has 60μW optical power launched into (10) port 1. The measured output powers at port 2, 3, and 4 are 0.004, 26.0, and 27.5 μW respectively. Determine the excess loss, the insertion losses between the input and output ports, the crosstalk and the split ratio for the device.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2016
